gre_general.value: General GRE is recommended for the PhD but not mandatory.
gre_general.quote: The Graduate Record Examination (GRE) score is recommended but not mandatory for application to our PhD program.

gre_subject.value: The Advanced Mathematics subject GRE is not required.
gre_subject.quote: Do you require the GRE in Advanced Math?

also.quote: We do not require this exam.

funding.value: The department says it has found support (teaching assistantships, fellowships, research assistantships) for all its PhD students; first-year TAships renew for a second year.
funding.quote: The department has been successful in finding support for all PhD students through teaching assistantships, fellowships and research assistantships.

entry_route.value: A bachelor's degree (or the equivalent of a four-year U.S. bachelor's) is enough; the department's master's programs are not a route into its PhD.
entry_route.quote: All students seeking admission to graduate study must hold a bachelor’s degree (or the equivalent of a four-year U.S. bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution as determined by the University of Pittsburgh).

also.quote: we do not regard our master’s degree programs as a way to qualify for our Ph.D. program

supervisor.value: Not stated on the pages checked

notes: Nearly all funding is teaching assistantships, so the department weighs English speaking ability heavily; it wants speaking and listening scores in the mid to high 20s on the old TOEFL scale for potential TAs.
